_comment_width: posWidth=16 -> 1600 ticks -> 17.35% range. Wide arm. Backtest 14d: 7.4% AERO APR, 0.07 rebalances/day, 100% in-range, -3.3% cost APR. Best sub-window median of any width tested (+8 vs -138 at w8).
_comment_ab: Three arms (w4/w8/w16) differ in targetWidth ONLY. Every other parameter is identical on purpose so the width is the single variable under test. Rebalance settings are copied verbatim from the live tBTC/cbBTC vault 0xF83648Df279004CdcEee1bEE3a92b9194Cd3b94E so the new arms behave identically to production.
_comment_seed: posId must be a 1600-tick-wide position minted with scripts/17-mint-cl-seed-position.js (CL_POOL=0x70aCDF2Ad0bf2402C957154f944c19Ef4e1cbAE1 CL_NPM=0x827922686190790b37229fd06084350E74485b72 CL_WIDTH=16).
_comment_helper: Deploy a FRESH helper with scripts/18-deploy-cl-helper.js and use the same address in every arm. Do NOT reuse 0x363a2E33196953b23EF45Bb9E79d4d1fD3007351 - it still exposes validateSpotWithinTwap/peekTwapSqrtPriceX96, so it predates the spot-based planner, the price-impact correction and the per-side burn mins, i.e. it still has the 50-percent-stranding bug.
_comment_wrappers: Deploys two CLWrapper instances per vault (token0-denominated and token1-denominated). Each is constructed against the bridge Storage and flipped to real governance with the rest of the stack.
